name: ownCloud-OCIS
description:
ownCloud Infinite Scale (OCIS) is the next-generation file sync and share platform. A complete rewrite of ownCloud built with Go, it's faster, more secure, and designed for modern cloud infrastructure.

**Key Features:**
- Modern, microservices-based architecture
- Built-in office document collaboration
- API-first design with extensive extensibility
- Advanced security and compliance features
- Kubernetes-native and cloud-ready

**Default Credentials:**
- Username: admin
- Password: admin (change immediately!)

**Security Notes:**
- Default JWT secrets are provided for initial setup
- **IMPORTANT**: Change all security tokens for production use
- Generate new secrets using: `openssl rand -base64 32`

**Important Notes:**
- This is the basic OCIS setup. For production use with SSL/TLS, consider the full deployment with Traefik reverse proxy
- OCIS_INSECURE is enabled for local network access
- For external access, you'll need proper domain configuration and SSL certificates
- If OCIS_URL is not set to your server's IP or domain, you may face issues logging in or starting up.

paths.name: Data Director
paths.description: Directory where OCIS stores user data, metadata, and internal files

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Directory where OCIS stores configuration files

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Web interface port for ownCloud OCIS

variables.name: OCIS Domain
variables.description: Primary domain for OCIS (e.g., ocis.yourdomain.com). Leave empty for IP-based access.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Custom admin password. Leave empty to use default 'admin' password.

variables.name: Insecure Mode
variables.description: Enable insecure mode for local network access without SSL. Set to 'false' for production with proper SSL setup.

variables.name: Proxy HTTP Address
variables.description: HTTP address for the proxy service to bind to. Use 0.0.0.0:9200 for all interfaces or specify IP:port.

variables.name: OCIS URL
variables.description: Full URL for OCIS access. Use https://your-server-ip:9200 or your domain. Keep https even with insecure mode.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: JWT secret for token signing. Leave empty to auto-generate a random secret. For production, use a secure random string.

variables.name: Machine Auth API Key
variables.description: Machine auth API key for internal service communication. Leave empty to auto-generate.

variables.name: Web UI Theme
variables.description: Custom theme server URL. Leave empty for default theme.

variables.name: Demo Users
variables.description: Create demo users (einstein, marie, richard, etc.) for testing. Set to 'true' to enable.

variables.name: SMTP Host
variables.description: SMTP server hostname for email notifications (optional)

variables.name: SMTP Port
variables.description: MTP server port (usually 587 for TLS or 465 for SSL)

variables.name: SMTP Username
variables.description: SMTP authentication username (optional)

variables.name: SMTP Password
variables.description: SMTP authentication password (optional)

variables.name: SMTP Security
variables.description: SMTP security method (none, starttls, ssl)

variables.name: Max File Size
variables.description: Maximum file upload size in bytes (default: 1GB)

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UserID for file permissions (99 = nobody user in Unraid)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GroupID for file permissions (100 = users group in Unraid)

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log level for OCIS (debug, info, warn, error)

variables.name: SMTP Sender
variables.description: Email address for sending notifications (e.g., 'ocis-noreply@yourdomain.com)

variables.name: Transfer Secret
variables.description: Transfer secret for secure file operations. Leave empty to auto-generate.
